The survey will cover 2.62 lakh households, capturing data on households, habitation-level, and community infrastructure along with livelihood details. All respondent households and community infrastructure assets will be geo-tagged. Furthermore, all data will be collected digitally. The survey will help evaluate the current socio-economic status of tribal households by focusing on key parameters such as family demographic details, economic aspects, education, health and nutrition status, housing, and infrastructure. It will also include a community focus ground discussion component and will capture the specific needs and challenges faced by tribal communities in accessing government welfare schemes, providing empirical data to support the development of targeted interventions that can improve tribal welfare. Finally, the survey will also increase awareness among partners and stakeholders who will be engaged in the implementation of the scheme.
